items.name: 团结雕像
items.subtitle: 古吉拉特邦凯瓦迪亚
items.image_hint: bronze-clad standing statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in a dhoti and shawl, hands at his sides, on a tall grey base by the Narmada river and Sardar Sarovar Dam. Best view: full figure head to base from the front or front-three-quarter, from the river bank or the approach bridge; sunset or clear sky. Exclude: Statue of Equality (Hyderabad), Ambedkar statues, Statue of Prosperity (Bengaluru), small Patel statues.

source.name: BBC News, 31 Oct 2018: India unveils world's tallest statue

items.notes: Vallabhbhai Patel. 182 m figure on a 58 m base (240 m total). Sculptor Ram V. Sutar.

items.name: 雷昆塞亚大佛
items.subtitle: 实皆省蒙育瓦
items.image_hint: huge golden-yellow standing Buddha with red robe accents on a hill at Bodhi Tataung near Monywa, a giant reclining Buddha lies in front of it. Best view: full standing figure from below on the hill path, or a wide shot with the reclining Buddha in the foreground. Exclude: the reclining Buddha alone, Kyaikhto seated Buddha, Shwedagon. Local names: Laykyun Setkyar, Bodhi Tataung standing Buddha, Monywa.

source.name: OrangeSmile: Laykyun Setkyar (116 m on a 13.5 m throne)

items.notes: Standing Buddha on a 13.41 m lotus throne (129.2 m total). Some sources round to 116 m.

items.name: 中原大佛
items.subtitle: 河南鲁山
items.image_hint: gilded copper standing Vairocana Buddha on a huge lotus throne atop stepped pedestals and a long staircase on a hill in Lushan county, Henan (Foquan Temple, Yaoshan). Best view: full statue including the lotus throne seen from the base of the stairs; clear sky. Exclude: Ushiku Daibutsu (Japan, bronze-coloured), Lingshan Grand Buddha (Wuxi), Tian Tan Buddha (Hong Kong, seated). Local names: 中原大佛, 鲁山大佛, 尧山大佛, 佛泉寺 (Foquan Temple).

source.name: Zhengzhou Evening News 2013-05-28 B06 (佛身108米, 莲花座20米, 总高208米)

items.notes: Figure 108 m + 20 m copper lotus throne = 128 m (the figure usually quoted, incl. by WPL) + 25 m + 55 m pedestals = 208 m. Our rule excludes thrones, so 108 m. With thrones counted for both it would still rank No. 3 (128 m < 129.2 m Laykyun incl. its 13.4 m throne); only WPL's mixed rule puts it at No. 2.

items.name: 牛久大佛
items.subtitle: 茨城县牛久市
items.image_hint: standing bronze Amitabha Buddha with right hand raised, dark bronze colour, in a park with flower fields at Ushiku, Ibaraki, Japan. Exclude: Spring Temple Buddha (gold, China), Kamakura Daibutsu (seated), Nara Daibutsu (indoor).

source.name: Guide to Japan (GLTJP) official info: 120 m incl. 20 m base

items.subtitle: 安徽九华山
items.image_hint: huge bronze standing Ksitigarbha (Dizang) monk with shaved head, holding a tall khakkhara staff in the right hand and a jewel in the left, on a lotus base at Dayuan Cultural Park, Mount Jiuhua, Anhui. Best view: full statue from the long axial plaza and stairs in front. Exclude: Jiuhua mountain temples, Spring Temple Buddha, Lingshan Buddha. items.name: 灵山大佛
items.subtitle: 江苏无锡

items.name: 信仰雕像
items.subtitle: 拉贾斯坦邦纳特德瓦拉
items.image_hint: huge copper-coloured seated Shiva in meditation, holding a trident, with a snake around the neck, on Ganesh Tekri hill at Nathdwara, Rajasthan. Best view: full seated figure from the front, ideally at dusk with lighting or clear blue sky. Exclude: Murudeshwar Shiva (sea, Karnataka), Adiyogi bust (Coimbatore), Kailashnath Mahadev (Nepal), Mangal Mahadev (Mauritius). Local names: Vishwas Swaroopam, Nathdwara Shiva statue.

source.name: The Daily Guardian: 112 m (369 ft) overall incl. a 34 m (110 ft) pedestal; Wikipedia 'Statue of Belief' same split

items.notes: Shiva ('Vishwas Swaroopam'), unveiled 29 Oct 2022. Overall 369 ft (112.5 m) incl. a 110 ft (33.5 m) pedestal (Wikipedia article; Daily Guardian: '34 m high pedestal, reaches 112 m'), so the seated figure is 369 - 110 = 259 ft = 78.9 m (derived). The 351 ft (107 m) in the NBM&CW builder report was the overall height during construction, before the Ganga stream was added to the hair (Rajasthan Tour Planner / Zee News). WPL lists 106 m statue / 112 m total, which treats the pedestal as only 6 m; contradicted by the 110 ft pedestal and the 110 ft viewing gallery. Explore Our India gives base 110 ft / shoulders 260 ft / trident tip 351 ft; the topmost point of the figure is the 369 ft hair ornament, so the figure height stays 259 ft. Previously ranked No. 4 in our draft.

items.name: 南山海上观音
items.subtitle: 海南三亚
items.image_hint: white three-faced Guanyin statue standing on a man-made island in the sea off Sanya, Hainan, connected by a long bridge. Best view: full statue from the shore or bridge with sea and sky, or aerial; must show three faces / sea setting. Exclude: Lady Buddha Da Nang, Tsz Shan Guanyin, Xiqiao Guanyin. source.name: Sina News, 25 Apr 2005: 南山海上观音 高108米 开光

items.notes: Three-faced white Guanyin on an artificial island. 108 m includes the 108-petal lotus seat and the Vajra platform that houses a hall; the figure-only 78 m is from WPL (no independent breakdown found) — flagged for review.

source.name: Myanmar Digital News (MDN): largest sitting Buddha in Myanmar, Phayathonzu

insights.text: 自由女神像从像底到火炬高46米，还不够高，没能上榜。
中国现限制30米以上雕像；荆州于2021—2022年拆除58米关羽像。
日本有9座雕像上榜，最新的一座也早在1994年就建成了。
榜上有4座于2022年起揭幕，分布在印度、泰国、菲律宾和印度尼西亚。
中原大佛常被标为128米，其实这包含了20米高的莲花座。
接下来：团结雕像，比全球其余雕像中的最高者还高66米。

scope_note: 统计范围：已建成的独立人物、神祇或动物雕像，包括半身像。高度仅计算雕像本体，从足部或坐姿底部至雕像最高点，包括手持的剑、火炬等物品，不含莲花座、基座、建筑或山体；含基座总高度在各卡片中标注。不含卧像及在建雕像。高度相同者并列排名。按雕像所在国家和地区归类，中国香港计入中国。

layout.image_prefer: the WHOLE statue clearly visible from head to feet/base (never cropped), the classic recognisable view of that exact statue, portrait orientation preferred, sky behind the head
